exact_theorems: Every Boolean relation with at most two tuples is majority-closed/bijunctive.
Arbitrary composition of polynomially many explicitly represented <=2-state side-code blocks reduces to 2-SAT via one local selector bit per block.
Three states are sharp: {100,010,001} is the Z3 side slice and yields Positive 1-in-3-SAT under composition.
global_firewall: Track the full six-way Schaefer ledger over the whole active language: 0-valid, 1-valid, AND/Horn, OR/dual-Horn, majority/bijunctive, minority/affine. Constants availability must be recorded explicitly because the four-case theorem with constants and six-case theorem without free constants have different formulations. Per-block labels alone do not compose.
determinant13: The frozen Z13 side slice has exactly two words and therefore lies in the universal two-state bijunctive island.

active_gate.target: Poly witness-preserving contraction of genuine >=3-state non-Schaefer side interactions before generic composition.
